omitted_tabs.reason: MySQL does not allow triggers on views.

gaps.reason: The backend accepts columns as an ordered list of scalar strings. A typed grid returns records; scalar-list projection is Decision 9. Do not submit records or silently omit existing aliases during ALTER.
Native grants/revokes are separate provider operations. Embedding their diff in a view edit requires the cross-operation dispatch contract in Decision 9.
The exposed materialized-view kind is metadata-only for this exact-version profile. It has no admitted create/alter operation; do not offer ordinary view DDL for it.

fields.label: Database
fields.help: Database name as a single native identifier; the selected object supplies this identity during alteration.

fields.label: Definer user
fields.help: Supply both user and host when changing the definer.
